Method of Attack: Creating fake or rogue WiFi access points to perform man-in-the-middle attacks
Spoofing MAC addresses and SSIDs of legitimate access points
Capturing and analyzing transferred data from connected users
Detecting access points created by Airbase-ng used for packet capture and injection
Attack Vector: Rogue WiFi access points impersonating legitimate ones
Indicators of Compromise: Beacon Management Frames with altered vendor, BSSID, supported rates, channel, country, max transmit power
SHA256 hash mismatches of access point signatures
